ontologies.name: Legal Knowledge Interchange Format
ontologies.description: Covers legal roles, norms, contracts, jurisdiction, liability, legislation, legal persons, and legal actions in formal ontological terms

ontologies.name: PROV Ontology
ontologies.description: Covers provenance, entities, activities, agents, influence, attribution, delegation, and associations between actors and their actions

ontologies.name: Schema.org
ontologies.description: Cross-domain vocabulary covering organizations, persons, events, creative works, products, places, and scientific topics for the web

ontologies.name: FIBO Foundations
ontologies.description: Financial Industry Business Ontology — covers financial instruments, parties, legal entities, contracts, markets, transactions, securities, and monetary amounts

ontologies.name: Political Roles and Processes
ontologies.description: Custom vocabulary covering political parties, elected offices, voting, legislative processes, international relations, elections, and government institutions

ontologies.name: Personal Conversational Ontology
ontologies.description: Lightweight ontology for extracting structured knowledge from personal dialogues, life narratives, and conversational text — covers interpersonal relationships, daily activities, preferences, goals, and life events
